rows.evidence: Q1: Sections II-III; the authors report their own leaf and canopy hyperspectral measurements at the Xiaotangshan experimental base, Beijing, on inoculated winter wheat, and derive and test new spectral indices (HI, PMI, YRI, AI) with classification accuracies (Table I, Fig. 4, Fig. 6) and DI regressions (Fig. 5, Fig. 7).
rows.notes: The study reports only detection/identification and severity estimation of powdery mildew, yellow rust and aphids from leaf-scale (accuracies 86.5-93.5%) and canopy-scale non-imaging spectra (82.4-87.6%; YRI vs DI R2 0.86). It does not report any farmer action, management response or prevention of further damage; detection is a precondition of the claimed pest-control effect. The work is at a single experimental site, mid-stage disease, with no spatial mapping of affected areas (authors note imaging applicability was not determined). Hence Q2 is 'no' and Q3-Q9 are 'no' by rule.

notes: Full text appears complete. Some numeric values (e.g., R2 values, site coordinates) are missing from the extracted text due to formatting, but the results are legible enough to rate.
